mouse_input.host_path: ATInputManager::OnMouseMove(0, dx, dy); OnButtonChanged(0, MouseLMB, state)
mouse_input.sensitivity: default preset: 16 integer host units per electrical transition; no mapping acceleration
mouse_input.capture: headless scheduled relative motion; GUI uses normal host mouse capture
mouse_input.observer: EXEC816_MOUSE_TRACE=1 logs MOUSE_HOST and passive MOUSE_PHASE in base scheduler cycles; unset for replay
mouse_input.controller_timing: Unmodified slow (scanline) scheduler: each phase delay clamps 0x1000000/remaining fixed-point distance to 1..256 scanlines. The passive observer timestamps output on the base CPU scheduler.

limits.scope: Compare matched optimized configurations and workloads: 10 gestures per widget cohort and 30 pointer motions/button edges. Development measurements, not qualification.
limits.explanation: 20.1 ms allows one PAL scanout-observation frame of phase difference. CPU/consumption budgets are explicit integration allowances, not measured jitter. No deliberate extra-frame wait is allowed. Exceedances require investigation before AS4 acceptance.

comparison.scope: Loaded allowance applies when either GEM clients or native scroll/disk work is active. Both frozen AS0 and matched AES-disabled comparisons are retained. Combined visibility includes the sequential label-observation upper bound.

validation.scope: 90 panel gestures (180 measured edges) across three cohorts and three loads; 90 pointer motions and 90 button edges across three cohorts. Three 100-frame continuous call-cost windows. Existing pixel/interaction, keyboard, progress, cleanup and guard checks retained.
validation.host_tests: No production or runner changes in IL3; IL2 host suite passed 389 tests with four historical-source skips. Documentation links/content checked.

limitations: Continuous offered traffic remains unchanged but measured completed work and scheduling phases vary; no equal-throughput claim.
Scanout observations have up to one PAL frame quantization. Combined label visibility is a sequential-observation upper bound.
Intermediate feedback observations retain small invalid-color crops; final pixel/oracle checks pass, but no flicker-free claim is made.
Development evidence on the pinned emulator/ROM/configuration, not full release qualification or physical-hardware qualification.
